import cv2,numpy as np
im=cv2.imread('first_frame.png'); hsv=cv2.cvtColor(im,cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)

'orange':((0,90,80),(30,255,255)),
'blue':((85,60,25),(135,255,230)),
'black':((0,0,0),(180,255,65)),
'lightgray':((0,0,145),(180,50,220)),
'bright':((0,0,180),(180,80,255)),
'wood':((0,25,30),(30,200,150)),
}
for name,(lo,hi) in sets.items():
 m=cv2.inRange(hsv,np.array(lo),np.array(hi))
 n,lab,st,cen=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(m)
 inds=np.argsort(st[1:,4])[::-1][:12]+1
 print('\\n',name,'total',np.sum(m>0))
 for i in inds:
  x,y,w,h,a=st[i];
